Apollo

Find relevant buyers and preserve useful sales context.

AOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Apollo supports prospect search, contact and account enrichment, and sales engagement workflows. MoreSpace can turn an agreed target market into an organized prospecting process, enriching permitted records, coordinating outreach ownership, and tracing qualified responses into a CRM pipeline.

Useful outputs

  • Reviewed account and contact lists with source context
  • Enriched CRM records and deduplicated prospect segments
  • Assigned follow-up tasks and prospect-to-pipeline reporting

Where we can apply it

  • Target buyer criteria → Apollo search → reviewed contact list → sales assignment.
  • Incomplete CRM record → enrichment request → identity check → approved update.
  • Prospect response → qualification → meeting record → source-to-pipeline analysis.
01

Use case 1

Find accounts and decision-makers using agreed ideal customer profile criteria.

02

Use case 2

Enrich authorized CRM records and review identity matches before updating fields.

03

Use case 3

Coordinate sales follow-up and compare prospect sources with meeting outcomes.

Inputs we need

  • Target account criteria, markets, and buyer roles
  • Authorized contact records and CRM field definitions
  • Sales ownership, contact rules, and enrichment allowance

Delivery sequence

  • Define the target market and required contact fields with the sales team.
  • Test search and enrichment results against representative account records.
  • Connect reviewed prospects to the agreed outreach and CRM handoff.

Expert review points

  • Review ambiguous identities and conflicting fields before applying CRM updates.
  • Approve recipient eligibility, suppression rules, and outreach responsibilities.
